text:
Maya: Pushed a compact mock for the Playground streaming controls. Stream, pause, snapshot, and rerun in a single inline row. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/compact-stream

Tom: Love the compact row. Concern: auto-scroll still grabs focus when new tokens come in. Can we only auto-scroll if user was at the bottom?

Rae: Yes, conditional auto-scroll. Also thinking about a tiny "snapshot" action that freezes the current partial output into a selectable block while generation continues. Users can copy mid-run.

Diego: From infra: snapshot should be client-side DOM clone to avoid extra backend calls. We'll keep resume pointer so resume doesn't re-run.

Maya: UX note: Snapshot pill should announce to screen readers "Snapshot created" and move focus optionally. A11y-Bot any tips?

A11y-Bot: Use aria-live="polite" and role=status for snapshot announcements. Provide keyboard shortcut like Alt+S and expose in shortcuts panel.

Tom: Token counter: propose a micro badge near the send button showing this-run estimate (e.g., "~88 toks"). Also session quota at top nav.

Rae: Microcopy: change "Stop" to "Finalize" for the action that locks the output. "Pause" for temporary halt. Less scary words.

Diego: Dev note: batching render updates into 50ms windows reduces layout thrash — we'll do that. Also preserve selection when new text appends.

Maya: I'll update Figma with compact and expanded variants. Please review before EOD. End thread.
